stem_text: A 1 kg block subjected to two simultaneous forces (2i^ + 3j^ + 4k^) N and (3i^ - j^ - 2k^) N is moved a distance of 25 m along (3i^ - 4j^) direction. The work done in this process is _____ J.

candidate_solve.derivation: 1. Resultant force: F_net = F_1 + F_2 = (2 + 3)i^ + (3 - 1)j^ + (4 - 2)k^ = (5i^ + 2j^ + 2k^) N. 2. Unit displacement vector along direction (3i^ - 4j^): u^ = (3i^ - 4j^) / sqrt(3^2 + (-4)^2) = (3i^ - 4j^) / 5. 3. Total displacement vector: s = 25 * u^ = 25 * (3i^ - 4j^) / 5 = (15i^ - 20j^) m. 4. Work done by net force: W = F_net . s = (5)(15) + (2)(-20) + (2)(0) = 75 - 40 = 35 J.

concept_model_selection.evidence: Superposition of simultaneous 3D vector forces and directional unit vector displacement projection

representation_translation.evidence: Normalizing direction vector (3i^ - 4j^)/5 and scaling by distance 25 m to construct displacement vector

reasoning_chain_length.evidence: Calculate resultant force F_net, calculate full displacement vector s, evaluate 3D dot product W = F_net . s

trap_exception_sensitivity.evidence: Remembering to normalize (3i^ - 4j^) by magnitude 5 before multiplying by 25 m

demand_proposal.rationale: Applying 3D vector dot product work calculations with resultant force and directional displacement
